02The one-minute versionThesis · story · evidence legend

My working thesis: activate the channel.

The field visits suggest that stock, price clarity and project paperwork can help activate the existing non-CCTV channel. This is a hypothesis to test, not a market-wide conclusion. proposal

01

The channel is there

Four main distributors carry Hikvision non-CCTV lines — but most are dual-brand, and category depth varies by distributor. desk · verify

02

The counter hesitates

Resellers told me they would stock alarms, intercom and access when distributor stock, pricing and demand are clear — and projects need approved-vendor paperwork. said

03

The plan

Enable the existing channel first, convert competitor specialists category by category, and prove it in 90 days with joint business plans. proposal

03Chapter 1 · The official channelDesk research · 4 AI research batches · to verify

Start at the top: the four distributors resellers name.

━ listed on Hikvision's public MEA distributor locator   ┅ reported via partner listings / resellers  ·  all per desk research desk · verify
The channel
4 distributors

Smartplus, AAAQ and Okaz Arabia are on Hikvision's public MEA locator, as is Future Technology for ICT (not mapped). City Systems is named by resellers as their main distributor. The register adds Abraj Al Samaha (intercom) and Fast Vision (displays). desk · verify

Reality check

Every distributor is dual-brand

AAAQ carries ESSER fire, City Systems carries Dahua & ZKTeco, Smartplus and Okaz also list Dahua. Asking for exclusivity won't work — winning shelf share category by category will. proposal

Below the distributors

Gold dealers (Steps Business Group, TeleNoc), e-commerce resellers and sub-dealer counters — which is where I went next.

What resellers said about their distributors
Steps Business Group · Olaya said

“Distributor / Okaz — low stock.” Projects are hard if the brand isn't on the approved vendor list.

Main distributor is City Systems. Would stock alarms if the distributor holds stock and demand is there.

So: the first lever isn't more resellers — it's distributor stock, price clarity and one clear category focus per distributor. proposal

09Chapter 2 · Olaya — Hikvision-linked showroomsReseller statements, as told

Hikvision is on the shelf. Non-CCTV stock varies.

Security Camera World

card: Hikvision dealer partner
  • Main distributor: City Systems. said
  • Alarm display on the wall, no alarm stock — would stock with distributor stock + demand. said
  • Best non-CCTV movers: 4–48-port switches and a “604” villa intercom (model to confirm). said
  • Ageing 2–4 MP camera / DVR stock to clear; some rural customers (e.g. Al Kharj) still take it. said

Adwaa Al Shugaa

card: ZKTeco · D-Link · LANAtech
  • Hikvision recently added; first cameras arrived without pricing. said
  • Core business is access control, time attendance and turnstiles — on ZKTeco.
  • Prime conversion target for MinMoe / access control. proposal

Olaya Brightness

said
  • Sells an AX PRO wireless alarm kit at SAR 485 + VAT. said
  • Sold its last attendance unit the previous day — demand exists at the counter. said

Steps Business Group

gold dealer · desk
  • Limited non-CCTV stock; “Okaz — low stock”; no LED displays. said
  • Projects need approved-vendor-list status; consultants lean to Honeywell, Bosch, Zeta. said
  • Training cadence mentioned: weekly to every 2–3 weeks. said

Shuruq Saudi

card lists Hikvision + 12 brands
  • TimeWatch turnstile quoted at SAR 10–11k. said
  • Told me they are TimeWatch's national distributor. said
  • Hikvision sits beside Suprema, Dahua, Virdi — one brand among many.
Pattern: brand trust is already there. What's missing at the counter is non-CCTV stock, a price list and project paperwork — all things a channel manager can fix with the distributor.

11Chapter 3 · What the field taught meField + reseller statements + desk research

Three signals that shape the plan.

01

Confidence lives at the distributor

  • “Okaz — low stock” (Steps). said
  • Cameras arrived without pricing (Adwaa). said
  • Would stock alarms with distributor stock + demand (Camera World). said
So → agree stock, price protection and one focus category with each distributor before pushing resellers.
02

Projects run on paperwork

  • Approved-vendor-list status decides projects (Steps). said
  • Consultants specify Honeywell / Bosch / Zeta. said
  • Fire is gated by Civil Defense approvals under SBC 801; HikFire model status not confirmed. desk · verify
So → build a compliance pack and presales / submittal support; register projects early.
03

Two markets, two playbooks

  • Malaz: SAR 195–287 panels, price-led small premises. said
  • Olaya: consultant-led projects and showroom buyers. field
  • Legacy wired installs slow wireless upgrades (Amniat). said
So → counter bundles (AX PRO kit, villa intercom, attendance) vs. spec-in support for projects.
Compliance note: UL Listed, UL Recognized and UL Classified are separate marks for different scopes — not sequential Saudi approval levels (UL Marks Hub). Saudi fire approvals sit with Civil Defense and need model-level confirmation from Hikvision.

13Chapter 4 · StrategyProposal · to agree with the team

Enable, convert, localise.

Pillar 1 · Tier 1–2 · 5 + 14

Enable the existing channel

  • One focus category per distributor, with stock and price protection.
  • Counter bundles: AX PRO kit, villa intercom, attendance terminal.
  • Regular reseller training and a simple price list.
Pillar 2 · Tier 3 · 17

Convert competitor specialists

  • Barrier, fire, access and ProAV specialists from the register.
  • Lead with ANPR, MinMoe, intercom and displays; add, don't replace.
  • Project registration so partners feel protected.
Pillar 3 · Projects

Localise & comply

  • Approved-vendor-list registrations and consultant spec-in.
  • Civil Defense document pack before any fire push.
  • Use local-manufacturing / Saudi-made content if confirmed. desk · verify

Scale2–3 categories, monthly forecast
Distributor alignmentStock commitments, price protection and a price list on focus SKUs.

Category prioritiesAgree which 2–3 categories lead Year 1.

16Chapter 5 · CloseQuestions · sources · limitations

Questions I'd bring to day one.

  1. FireWhich HikFire panels, detectors and call points hold Saudi Civil Defense approval today?
  2. BarriersIs boom-barrier and speed-gate stock held locally — and is local assembly planned?
  3. Access controlHow is HikCentral licensed and margined against BioStar and BioTime?
  4. IntercomIs there an MDU / SIP or Hik-Connect option hosted for KSA apartment retrofits?
  5. AlarmAny AX PRO bundling incentives or central-monitoring integrations for dealers?
  6. ProAVIs there a Riyadh demo space for LED and interactive flat panels?
